summary: The gyomu-workflow package powers the snapshot workflow engine for the Gyomu CLI. It provides robust capabilities for orchestrating execution pipelines, managing checkpoints, resolving target files, and validating project structures.
responsibilities: Manage the end-to-end execution of snapshot workflows and associated actions.
Persist and update workflow state and execution checkpoints.
Resolve, filter, and validate target files and Python package structures.
Define configuration schemas and request models for workflow operations.

capabilities.name: Workflow Orchestration
capabilities.description: Orchestrates the execution of snapshot workflows, coordinating pipeline steps, validating request parameters, and running actions on target files.

capabilities.name: Checkpoint Management
capabilities.description: Manages snapshot state, persistence through checkpoints, and history tracking across workflow runs.

capabilities.name: Target Resolution and Filtering
capabilities.description: Resolves target files and directories for snapshot execution, applying file filters and pattern matching.

capabilities.name: Configuration and Validation
capabilities.description: Defines core data models, request configurations, and validation rules for snapshot execution and Python package structures.

design_decisions: Encapsulates workflow execution logic into modular components handling distinct concerns such as action execution, state management, and target resolution.
Leverages dedicated error models and validation steps to ensure correctness of snapshot requests and project structures before execution.
usage_guidance: Use the core run and translation modules to initiate and configure snapshot workflows based on project requirements.
Rely on checkpoint utilities to track state and maintain execution history across workflow runs.
Configure file filters and target options using the provided models to scope snapshot operations accurately.
